title: story-032 twice ships a false 'NudgeStreamer is unaffected' claim
storyEvidence: story-032 at :126-128 and :383-385 twice asserts NudgeStreamer 'is unaffected'. The story's wider four-revert blast radius IS authorised, disclosed and faithful (032-*.md:155-178, Concerns section 1 - the intake hypothesis was REFUTED).
description: Law-2 mirror of L-04 (D-26-06). The deviation is narrow and specific: the MECHANISM claim ('reads _nudgeTokenIndex') is TRUE; the CONCLUSION is FALSE, because what changed is WHAT A `true` FROM isNudgeToken TRANSITIVELY WITNESSES. 'Only what is refused' IS the change to the reachable state set. NudgeStreamer.registerStream gates on isNudgeToken and nothing else, so removing the config-completeness precondition on the whitelist directly widens what registerStream will admit.
impact: A reader of the story will not learn that a new pre-commission stranding route was opened, which is exactly the footgun filed as L-04.
recommendation: Correct both story sites (:126-128, :383-385) to state that isNudgeToken's transitive witness changed, and fold L-04's remediation in while the story is STILL OPEN (see F-05-032) rather than filing it as a follow-up.
dualRoute: Dual-routed for the same reason as Q-01/F-01-031. Paired with L-04 (D-26-06). MUST NOT be folded into the QA/gas bundle.
